'''HK-Taskmaster''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in [[HK-47]]'s [[Droid Army|droid army]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. It was destroyed by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].
